name: Angling Table

pages.text: Open the table, insert a supported rod and choose its accessories in the native menu.

pages.title: Obtaining and placing
pages.text: Craft the Angling Table through JEI and place it. Interacting opens the native rod-upgrade menu.

pages.title: Accessory slots
pages.text: Place a supported rod and the desired accessory in the matching slots. Hooks change fishing eligibility; lines change reeling characteristics. Take the completed rod and inspect its tooltip. Not every rod from another mod supports this route.

pages.title: Fishing conditions
pages.text: Accessories do not erase fish requirements for dimension, fluid, depth, climate, time, weather or season. The Fishing Journal shows native requirements; compare them before casting again.
